theme.description: Trustworthy, fresh, local Indian but modern. Warm, tactile, and rooted in Indian dairy heritage without feeling like generic tech SaaS.

palette_guide.muted: #EBE6DF (Warm Oat) - Inactive tabs, disabled states, product card backgrounds

headings.usage: H1, H2, H3, prominent card titles. Use tracking-tight.

mono.usage: Specifically for the 8:00 PM cutoff countdown timer to ensure fixed-width digits.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Mobile-first, generous touch targets. High padding in cards to emphasize premium D2C feel.
spacing_and_layout.container: max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-background pb-24 relative shadow-xl sm:border-x sm:border-border
spacing_and_layout.grid: Bento-style for dashboard summaries. Minimal 1-col for mobile scrolling feeds.

mobile_bottom_tab_bar.layout: fixed bottom-0 w-full max-w-md bg-white border-t border-border shadow-[0_-8px_30px_-15px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] z-50 rounded-t-2xl pb-safe
mobile_bottom_tab_bar.tab_styling: flex flex-col items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-medium transition-colors

cards.default: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-border/50 shadow-[0_4px_24px_-8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)] p-5 overflow-hidden
cards.product: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-border/50 overflow-hidden flex flex-col group
cards.product_image_wrapper: bg-muted aspect-square flex items-center justify-center p-4 relative
cards.subscription: bg-white rounded-2xl p-5 border-l-4 border-l-primary shadow-sm

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground rounded-full font-medium px-6 py-3 sm:py-6 shadow-[0_4px_14px_0_rgba(217,138,60,0.39)] hover:bg-primary/90 hover:shadow-lg transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.outline: border-2 border-primary text-primary rounded-full bg-transparent hover:bg-primary/5

badges.active: bg-green-100 text-green-800 border-none rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold
badges.pending: bg-orange-100 text-orange-800 border-none rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold
badges.skipped: bg-stone-100 text-stone-600 border-none rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold

login.layout: Centered content. Rich organic background texture or warm oat color.
login.form: Large input field for phone number, clean OTP 6-box input. Primary button spans full width. OTP dev default: 123456.

dashboard.hero_card: Next delivery context prominently displayed. Use 'cards.subscription' styling.
dashboard.bento_grid: 2-column grid. Left: Bottle Balance (icon: glass bottle, value). Right: Wallet Balance (icon: wallet, ₹ value).

subscription_detail.sticky_action: Bottom sticky bar sitting just above the mobile nav containing 'Save Changes' and the 8 PM Cutoff Timer.

icons.style: Duotone weight for premium feel. Use Fill weight for active bottom tabs.

product_milk.description: Glass bottle of fresh farm milk

implementation_instructions.tailwind: Add the CSS variables to your global CSS and map them in tailwind.config.js under colors.
implementation_instructions.shadcn_overrides: Do NOT use default shadcn border-radius or gray borders. Override global CSS variables exactly as provided. Remove standard Vercel-look borders from Cards.
implementation_instructions.javascript_note: Ensure components are built using .jsx/.js as per project setup, avoiding TypeScript strict types if .js is strictly mandated, but use standard React prop validation.
implementation_instructions.calendar_component: Customize shadcn calendar heavily for the 30-day view. Inject 'day_locked' styling based on a simple 'isBeforeCutoff' check against today's date.
